name: @kyoube/mai-agent
description: Single-binary LinkedIn autonomous agent. Vercel AI SDK base + embedded CDP + ICP-as-soul system prompt + ported mai-linkedin primitives. Operator-facing CLI: `mai`. Private package; not for general distribution.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && chmod +x dist/cli/main.js && npm run build:web && npm run build:native && npm run build:tauri-ui
scripts.build:web: esbuild src/web/main.tsx --bundle --minify --jsx=automatic --external:/vendor/* --outfile=dist/web/app.js && tailwindcss -i src/web/style.css -o dist/web/style.css --minify && cp src/web/index.html dist/web/index.html && cp -r src/web/vendor dist/web/vendor
scripts.build:native: node-gyp rebuild || echo '[mai] cgevent native addon build skipped (Xcode CLT missing) — hardware input mode unavailable; cdp mode unaffected'
